sentences.text:
The appellant is apprehending for his arrest in connection with Crime No.119/2024 registered at Police Station Piplani, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376,
376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)
(ii) and 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
3. As per prosecution story, it is alleged that prosecutrix was studying in class 12th in the year 2021 and present appellant was also studying in the same school.
They knew each other.
Appellant took the prosecutrix in rental room where he committed rape with her on several occasions on the false pretext of marriage.
Thereafter, prosecutrix lodged the report against the appellant.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted that in alternative, prosecutrix was a consenting party.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Appellant is a student having no criminal record.
Prosecutrix is senior student than the appellant.
As per prosecution story itself, appellant was below 18 years at the time of incident.
Under such circumstances, prayer is made to enlarge the appellant on anticipatory bail.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that appellant committed rape with the prosecutrix against her will.
Appellant is still absconding.
Prosecutrix belongs to Scheduled Caste and Sections 18 and 18A of the SC/ST Act creates a bar to grant of anticipatory bail for a person accused of an offense under the Act.
Therefore, this appeal of the appellant may be rejected.
6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, this is not a case, in which, discretion of granting anticipatory bail to the appellant may be exercised.
Therefore, appeal filed by the appellant under Section 14-A(1) of SC/ST Act r/w Section 438 of Cr.P.C is hereby dismissed.
